subject: Trial governance & scope shift: acceptance criteria and next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Martin <ana.martin@meridianretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: Trial governance & updated acceptance questions

Hi Ana,

Thanks for a productive discovery earlier. Attached are the draft success metrics and a mutual action plan (MAP) you can review.

Recap of what we heard from your team:
- Primary use case: conversational cart assistance + cart item origin extraction
- Secondary (ask in call): extract shipping estimates from order confirmations (new)
- Key constraints: PII redaction, <30ms average token latency target for API, on-prem audit requirements

Proposed next steps & owners:
1) Confirm final success criteria by 08/28 — Ana (Meridian) + Monica (Redwood)
2) Ingest two weeks of sample orders for initial eval — Meridian data team
3) We run 2-week evaluation (8/31–9/13) with weekly checkpoints — Karthik + Monica
4) Final acceptance / decision call targeting week of 9/14

Questions where we need clarity before re-baselining:
- Is the shipping-estimate extraction high priority enough to include in the initial trial scope?
- Do you want us to run the evaluation on a masked subset or provide an on-prem connector for full data?

Attachments (stubs):
- trial-success-metrics.xlsx (metrics draft)
- mutual-action-plan.docx (MAP v1)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call to align.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: trial-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB); mutual-action-plan.docx (docx, 36KB)

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear notes.

Quick answers and an additional ask from our ops team:
- We can confirm acceptance criteria draft in principle, but we need to add shipping-estimate extraction as a prioritized secondary use case. If you can include that in the mid-trial re-baseline that would be ideal.
- We will start by providing a masked sample dataset (see attached sample-orders.csv). The data team would also like to understand how token-level redaction will be handled during the evaluation.
- SOC 2 evidence request: can you share a short checklist or pointer to your SOC 2 controls relevant to data access for the trial? It will determine whether we ask for on-prem connector.

We can confirm owners: Ana (Meridian) and Dana Li (data_ops@meridianretail.com). We prefer weekly progress notes and a mid-trial decision gate after week one of the trial.

Attached: sample-orders.csv

Best,
Ana

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ana Martin <ana.martin@meridianretail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Trial governance & updated acceptance questions

Thanks Ana — adding shipping-estimate extraction is feasible. Suggested adjustments to keep the trial within a two-week scope:

- Scope change: Add one additional evaluation intent (shipping-estimate extraction) but run as candidate intent in parallel rather than a hard gate for acceptance.
- Acceptance re-baseline: Keep primary success metrics (precision/recall on cart extraction) as the main acceptance. For shipping estimate, we propose: 75% extraction accuracy and TTL for false-positive rate <5% during evaluation.
- Timeline change: Move ingest start to 8/31, run two-week run (8/31–9/13) with a mid-trial decision point 9/7. If shipping-estimate fails to meet the candidate threshold by 9/7, we document a follow-up sprint instead of failing the overall trial.
- Data handling: We can accept masked CSV for initial run. For SOC 2 and audit, I'll attach a short controls summary. If Meridian requires an on-prem connector we can discuss options but that will extend baseline timelines by ~2–3 weeks.

Kimberly/Monica — can you confirm with Meridian that the 'candidate intent' approach is acceptable and that the data team will share sample schemas by 8/28? Ana — can you confirm Dana is looping in the data team?

Thanks,
Karthik

Ana — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the sample dataset.

Confirming agreed changes:
- Shipping-estimate extraction added as a 'candidate intent' (will be evaluated in parallel; not a hard acceptance gate)
- Trial window: ingest 8/31, evaluation 8/31–9/13, mid-trial gate 9/07, final review 9/14
- Owners: Ana (Meridian) / Dana Li (data_ops@meridianretail.com) and Karthik + Monica on Redwood side
- Acceptance metrics: primary intents: >85% combined precision/recall; candidate intent (shipping estimate): >=75% accuracy for initial acceptance, follow-up sprint if unmet
- Data: masked CSV sufficient for initial run. Redwood will provide a data-handling note and SOC2 controls summary (attached)
